use.zh-CN: 弹性环受压形变，为手臂或腿部控制练习提供阻力
use.en: An elastic ring deforms under compression to resist selected arm or leg control exercises

caution.zh-CN: 检查环体和接触垫，缓慢施压；不是承重吊环，勿悬挂身体
caution.en: Check the ring and contact pads; apply pressure slowly. It is not a suspension ring and must not support body weight

evidenceScope.zh-CN: ACSM支持一般抗阻训练原则；厂商页面只核对本条目的结构，不证明效果或安全性。具体使用以型号手册为准。
evidenceScope.en: ACSM supports general resistance-training principles; the manufacturer page identifies structure only, without establishing efficacy or safety. Consult the model manual.
